name: Shuukatsu!
source:
The protagonist, due to his fear of young girls, aims to be an all-boys school's teacher. But because one of his relatives' recommendation he is assigned to an all-girls school instead. However, he becomes quite popular in the class.

At his school, there is a legend among the students. If two people manages to do the business on the field trip, they will be happy together forever. And there're several girls who are interested in the protagonist.

And thus, the much-anticipated field trip begins.

[Edited from: [url=http://www.interheart.co.jp/index.php?cID=656]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角因害怕年轻女孩而立志成为一名男子学校的老师。但由于一位亲戚的推荐，他被分配到一所女子学校。然而，他在班上很受欢迎。

在他的学校，学生中流传着一个传奇人物。如果两个人在实地考察中成功地完成了生意，他们就会永远幸福地在一起。还有几个对主角感兴趣的女孩。

就这样，万众期待的实地考察开始了。

[编辑自：[url=http://www.interheart.co.jp/index.php?cID=656]官方网站[/url]]
